literal_phrase: Removing a from L_b leaves an octahedron on A and an opposite three-set B
precise_reading: Delete degree3vertex a and CAP its triangular boundary A; the resulting closed sphere is the octahedron on A union B. Literal deletion alone leaves that octahedron minus the face A, a disk.
A_and_B_opposite_faces_refer_to: The capped octahedral sphere, not the punctured disk.
